净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Mutates parent factor_nonlinear_deviation by scaling the close deviation from SMA20 by rolling volatility of returns. This adjusts for market regime changes, potentially improving IC and mutual information while preserving the bounded nonlinearity and rank stability from the parent. The hyperbolic tangent compresses outliers.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

tanh((close - SMA20(close,20)) / (volatility(close,20) * SMA20(close,20)))

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

tanh((close - SMA20(close,20)) / (volatility(close,20) * SMA20(close,20)))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：ts_mean(close) → 窗口 20 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  2. 步骤2：subtract(close, v1(ts_mean)) → 减法：x - y
  3. 步骤3：ts_std(close) → 窗口 20 的滚动标准差 (ts_std_dev的别名)
  4. 步骤4：ts_mean(close) → 窗口 20 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  5. 步骤5：multiply(v3(ts_std), v4(ts_mean)) → 乘法：x × y
  6. 步骤6：divide(v2(subtract), v5(multiply)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  7. 步骤7：tanh(v6(divide)) → 计算双曲正切值

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
tanh计算双曲正切值

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 sma20：close.rolling(window=20, min_periods=20).mean()
  2. 计算 deviation：close - sma20
  3. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  4. 计算 vol20：ret.rolling(window=20, min_periods=20).std()
  5. 计算 scaled_dev：deviation / (vol20 * sma20 + 1e-8)
  6. 计算 factor：np.tanh(scaled_dev)

  2. MA20(close,20) — MA20(x) → 20 期移动均线

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volatility_scaled_deviation(df): df_copy = df.copy() sma20 = df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(window=20, min_periods=20).mean() deviation = df_copy["str">'close'] - sma20 ret = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() vol20 = ret.rolling(window=20, min_periods=20).std() scaled_dev = deviation / (vol20 * sma20 + 1e-8) factor = np.tanh(scaled_dev) df_copy["str">'factor_volatility_scaled_deviation'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_volatility_scaled_deviation']
